title: Alien Oracle in Purple Field
description: A tall grey alien with three eyes and multiple faces on its body stands in the foreground holding a glowing red orb containing a tiny silhouetted figure. In the background, a hiker with a backpack walks along a winding path through a purple lavender field toward a large red celestial body in the sky, surrounded by geometric triangular patterns and floating alien faces.
prompt: A surreal scene featuring a tall grey alien with three eyes and multiple smaller faces on its torso and legs, standing in a purple lavender field while holding out a glowing red orb with a tiny human silhouette inside. In the background, a lone hiker with backpack walks a winding path toward a large textured red planet in the sky. Geometric triangles and floating alien face patterns fill the upper portion. Black ink drips at the base, ink and watercolor style with clean linework.
